Subject: Proposed sandbox working session: prompt tuning + surge (Dec 3 or 4)

Hi Evan —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. To make the most of the POC sandbox, we'd like to combine three focused items into a single hands-on session:

- Prompt review and targeted tuning (30–40m) — bring 3 example prompts/cases you care about
- Routing validation (15–20m) — confirm policy routing and fallback behavior for short/long queries
- Surge/load validation (30–45m) — run a short controlled burst (up to 500 RPS simulated) to validate autoscale and KV cache behavior

Proposed windows (PST):
- Thu Dec 3, 10:00–11:30
- Fri Dec 4, 13:00–14:30

I attached a draft runbook and a minimal surge-test plan so you can scan prerequisites. Please let me know which slot works and any constraints (VPN, allowlist IPs, or team members who must be present).

If neither works, we can split into two shorter sessions (prompt + routing first, surge test later).

Thanks — looking forward to the hands-on run.

—Olga

Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Sandbox surge test + prompt-tuning working session — notes & action items

Team — thanks for a productive session today. Below is a short recap and the agreed next steps.

Recap highlights:
- Prompt tuning: we iterated on Evan's three prompts; small template change (+system prompt guardrails) reduced hallucination cases in the short prompt by ~18% (see summary table in shared doc).
- Routing: validated that policy rules route long-context cases to the larger model family and short responses to the low-latency variant; verified automatic fallback to the safety model on a simulated error.
- Surge test: executed the agreed pattern (5m ramp, 10m steady at 350 RPS, 5m ramp down). Observations:
  - Autoscaler reacted at 210s with an additional GPU node; 95th p99 latency remained under 420ms for cached prefixes
  - Cold-start token cost spiked as expected; caching gains visible after ~40s of steady traffic

Action items (owners + ETA):
1) Evan / Fjord — share sanitized prompts and confirm redaction by Mon Dec 6 EOD (owner: Evan)
2) Markus / Redwood — upload KV cache dashboard and export of p99 latency traces by Tue Dec 7 EOD (owner: markus_klein)
3) Dev / Redwood — open ticket with infra team to tune autoscaler threshold (target: reduce time-to-scale by 20%) by Wed Dec 8 (owner: dev_patel)
4) Olga / Redwood — prepare short partner-facing recap + next session proposal (owner: olga_petrov) — draft due Fri Dec 10

Next session proposal:
- Topic: extended multi-tenant routing scenarios + canary rollouts for model variants
- Proposed dates: Dec 16 or Dec 17, 11:00–12:30 PST

Attachments: post-session-metrics.csv, prompt-iter-summary.md

If I've missed anything or you want a different timeline, reply-all and we'll adjust.

Thanks again — appreciated the focus.

—Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
